Portrait atlas 1024x1536, EXACT 8 columns x 12 rows, every cell 128x128 output =32x32 logical pixels at 4x. First 11 rows each hold exactly ONE animal identity, final row EMPTY transparent. Each row has eight matched movement frames: south idle, south step, west idle, west step, east idle, east step, north idle, north step. Align paw contact baseline at native y=27, center x=16, clear 3 logical pixel padding. Animals occupy about 18–24 logical pixels across/height, no large portrait heads, no clothes, no people. South faces show expressive tiny eyes/nose; north frames show the back of head and body, not a face; left/right are genuinely turned body orientations. Species anatomy remains recognizable from the overhead camera, four tiny feet, cat tails and dog muzzles. Row order: orange tabby cat; black cat with readable warm rim highlights; white cat with soft warm-gray shading; calico cat; gray cat; Siamese cat with cream body and dark mask/paws; tan Aspin Philippine mixed-breed dog with upright ears and curled tail; brown puppy; white puppy; black dog; black-and-white spotted dog. Consistent cat sizes and consistent dog scale, puppies slightly smaller. Keep markings perfectly consistent across each row's eight frames. Crisp limited palette, cute but natural proportions. No food bowls, hearts or unrelated icons within animal cells.
